logistics.format: Remote-proctored exam delivered via Zoom on Windows or macOS; 13 multiple-choice + 42 discrete-option multiple-choice (DOMC) questions

formal: Recommended: 6-12 months of hands-on Docker experience

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, foundational: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded container-operations scope and one-year background support associate Docker knowledge; multiple-choice-only testing, vendor-only recognition and competing Kubernetes credentials weaken its wider security signal.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recommended Docker experience and container-operations scope support associate platform knowledge at an accessible cost. Multiple-choice-only assessment, general infrastructure focus and weaker recorded market relevance limit security hiring assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded Docker exam is entirely multiple choice and centers on general container infrastructure. Despite a one-year profile, I discount the Associate label because no hands-on delivery is assessed and the record notes weaker relevance beside Kubernetes credentials.
